name: Da Vinci
tagline: Maps where parallel agent lanes touch and flags cross-contamination early
description: Draws the map of a multi-agent setup: which work lanes touch which, where handoffs and shared files create overlap, and where one lane's output can leak into another's. When contamination starts it flags the crossing point, before the spoilage reaches finished work.
author: IAmMichaelSweet
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
